faqs.question: Please tell me a little about the villa.
faqs.answer: We are a 5 bedroom, 5 bathroom, ocean view villa located in Bacolet, just five minutes drive from the port.

faqs.question: How many people can the villa accommodate?
faqs.answer: We can accommodate a maximum of thirteen guests.

faqs.question: Where are you located?
faqs.answer: We are in Bacolet, Tobago, just five minutes drive from Scarborough.

faqs.question: How can I book the villa?
faqs.answer: Please reach out via WhatsApp at 868-682-1750 to discuss further and complete your booking.

faqs.question: Can a small group or individual stay?
faqs.answer: Our one bedroom self-contained suite option is ideal for up to four guests.

faqs.question: Can payments be made in installments?
faqs.answer: Sure. Ask about our payment plan at booking.

faqs.question: What are check-in and check-out times?
faqs.answer: Check-in is 3:00pm and check-out is 11:00am. The team can try to accommodate other times when bookings permit; check-outs after 3:00pm incur an additional charge.

faqs.question: What amenities are included?
faqs.answer: The villa offers a smoke-free environment, free WiFi, cable TV, a private pool, air-conditioned bedrooms, linens, toiletries, pool and bath towels, first aid kits, fire extinguishers, emergency contacts, an outdoor grill, irons, hair dryers, and drying racks.

faqs.question: Are events or commercial activities allowed?
faqs.answer: Events or commercial activities require prior agreement from villa management and charges may apply. The villa is in a residential area, so music and noise should be considerate and loud music should stop by 11:00pm.

faqs.question: What cancellation policy applies?
faqs.answer: More than 60 days before arrival: loss of 10% of the rental cost. 30-60 days: loss of 50%. 14-30 days: loss of 80%. Less than 14 days: loss of 100%.

Ground floor: two self-contained adjoining suites that may be joined to form one two-bedroom suite. Maximum 7 guests.
